results.expressions: All 19 authored expression examples parse: boolean connectives, multiplicity tests, equality/subset, set operations, join/product/transpose, quantifiers, call. Output includes ExprUnary wrapper, AND/OR list normalization, and qualified field X <: r. This is parser acceptance and AST observation, not parse(print(IR)) equivalence.
results.module: Signature multiplicity flags observed; named fact/assertion are listed; resolved command formula includes facts, expands predicate call to existential quantifier and negates assertion for check. Preserve authored target via syntax-aware adapter, not command formula reconstruction.

These match zero-based UTF-16 indices 13 and 32, not UTF-8 offsets 16 and 37; sample includes supplementary Unicode, accented scalar and CRLF. Labels show 1-based line/column and inclusive end in this sample. Do not generalize to tabs, EOF, AST spans or file-reader normalization without fixtures.

limitations: No printer or elaborator exists in this spike, so full tag round-trip is not established. Several reference tags are exercised within expressions; standalone declaration identity, calls with binary-valued actuals and all negative type cases remain untested.

The probe uses parseEverything_fromString; the production worker uses parseEverything_fromFile. Coordinate semantics in that path, comment/trivia attribution, lexer behavior with tabs and supplementary characters in identifiers need independent testing.

Resource attempts under 1 GiB and 2 GiB address-space limits failed JVM startup; final bounded run used 8 GiB address-space, 256 MiB heap, two visible CPUs and 20 CPU seconds. This is not a reference-laptop budget validation.

No solve, SQL, production mutation, corpus access or network upload. SourcePolicy currently enforces 32768 UTF-8 bytes; applying a no-import policy to all modes is a proposed contract decision, not established by this probe.
